name: Intraday RSI(2) reversion, 15-minute bars
hypothesis: The daily RSI(2) reversion rule on AMZN and AAPL measured +117 to +150 bps a trade (t above 5) because short-term overshoots in liquid names are partly given back. The same overshoot on 15-minute bars, bought only while price is above a two-day average, may give back too, with fewer and less noisy bars than 5-minute data. Written before any run. This is the idea with the most outside support and the least reason to think intraday spreads allow it; a gross edge that costs erase is the likely result.
